mapper.select: SELECT id, record_id AS recordId, card_number AS cardNumber, channel_code AS channelCode, channel_name AS channelName, open_type AS openType, person_code AS personCode, person_id AS personId, person_name AS personName, department_id AS departmentId, DATE_FORMAT(swing_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS swingTime, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, open_result AS openResult, enter_or_exit AS enterOrExit, raw_json AS rawJson, DATE_FORMAT(ingested_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS ingestedAt FROM door_swipe_rule_record WHERE record_id = #{recordId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, record_id AS recordId, card_number AS cardNumber, channel_code AS channelCode, channel_name AS channelName, open_type AS openType, person_code AS personCode, person_id AS personId, person_name AS personName, department_id AS departmentId, DATE_FORMAT(swing_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS swingTime, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, open_result AS openResult, enter_or_exit AS enterOrExit, raw_json AS rawJson, DATE_FORMAT(ingested_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS ingestedAt FROM door_swipe_rule_record
ORDER BY swing_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
